about.body: I'm Francis Jacob Mwambene - Cisco online. I'm a Tanzanian software developer and product builder, currently studying at Don State Technical University in Russia. I enjoy making complex systems easier to use and useful ideas possible.
about.approachBody: My background spans full-stack development, product management, networking and technical support. That mix keeps me interested in the complete experience: the interface people touch, the systems behind it, and the problem worth solving.
about.globalBody: Growing up in Tanzania and continuing my education in Russia has given me a personal connection to building across cultures. I bring that curiosity to each project, and keep learning through practical work.
about.languageBody: English and Kiswahili: fluent. French: basic. Russian is part of my current environment; no fluency is claimed.
